interventions.detail: Created a uv venv (Python 3.12) since system pip on Ubuntu 24.04 is externally-managed
Installed torch 2.7.1/torchvision 0.22.1 cu128 wheels and set TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST=12.0 for Blackwell sm_120
pip install -e . must use --no-build-isolation (with FORCE_CUDA=1) so the CUDA extension builds against the installed torch
Installed python3-dev because Python.h was missing during the extension build
Added 'import torch' to groundingdino/__init__.py so that 'from groundingdino import _C' can resolve libc10.so
Pinned transformers==4.44.2 and numpy<2.3 for compatibility with GroundingDINO's BERT wrapper
Installed libgl1 and libglib2.0-0 for opencv-python
Used curl instead of wget (not present) to download the weights
